scope: three dynamic bodies plus floor; x/y/angle/vx/vy every tick; identical initial fixture per lane

timing_contract.warmup: one invocation per case/backend/config before timed repetitions
timing_contract.process_wall_seconds: process creation, runtime startup, world creation, simulation, serialization, download and stdout capture; comparison excluded
timing_contract.cpu_parallelism: independent native oracle processes launched by a bounded thread pool; process startup is included
timing_contract.gpu_kernel_ms: probe-reported CUDA events; world setup plus all simulation steps; excludes allocation/upload/download
timing_contract.telemetry: whole-device nvidia-smi 100ms samples; peaks are not process-exclusive
timing_contract.fixture_limits: lanes repeat one fixture, no game RNG/spawns/scoring, no dense-board or candidate-search speedup established

telemetry_summary.scope: whole-device sampled every100ms; includes desktop/context usage; GPU-util is not occupancy or a saturation proof

parity_summary.scope: all lanes repeat the same fixture percase; repeated counts do not broaden physics coverage

measurement_conditions.cpu_comparison_scope: native oracle processes; startup, world creation, simulation, serialization/stdout capture included; not a CPU throughput ceiling
